messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline 25 mg tablets

Sertraline 100 mg tablets
Sertraline oral solution, 20 mg per mL
Sertraline 150 mg capsules
Sertraline 200 mg capsules
Capsule strengths are based on sertraline itself.
A 150 mg capsule contains 168 mg of sertraline hydrochloride.
A 200 mg capsule contains 224 mg.
Capsule appearance and imprints differ between manufacturers.
Triplet: ["Sertraline", "has concentration", "20 mg per mL"]

The relation 'has concentration' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject dosage form has a specified concentration of the active ingredient.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
B. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
C. 'is salt form of': The subject drug is a salt form of the active pharmaceutical ingredient specified by the object entity.
D. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
E. 'has administration time': The subject dosage form takes the specified amount of time to administer.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
